scope: Engineering lifecycle and offline-program startup only; official 1:1 acceptance remains blocked
problem: The previous worker activates before preparing its new code cache. A cache-token-only update of that shipped worker fails real offline reload after it takes control.
changes: Prepare the matching runtime entry and all 29 JS/CSS URLs declared in that HTML before skipWaiting; reject missing/mismatched entry or dependency failures without replacing the working worker.
Read every dependency response body while other requests are pending; normalize decoded body encoding/length headers before caching.
Support root/index.html query aliases from the prepared entry, and prevent a future runtime HTML from overwriting the current offline entry.
Keep the existing media cache and do not alter IndexedDB/localStorage user data; add the actual-worker browser flow to PR CI.

commands.command: git diff --check; node --check sw.js; node --check tests/service-worker-browser.cjs; git diff --quiet 615db45 -- assets

baselineTraceability: The fixture worker equals git show 615db45:sw.js byte-for-byte. The previous app/index reconstructed by replacing pages-33 with pages-32 match the prior verification source hashes. For the before run, only the old worker cache token is changed to force a new-cache activation. The broken/recovered next-release runtime is simulated and is not a published game version.

browserConditions.runtimeTransport: Real gzip HTML, JS and CSS responses; worker native response bodies are decoded before cache storage.

limitations: Program entry, scripts and styles are prepared; songs, artwork, fonts outside that HTML and optional modules are not all downloaded by this change. The offline screenshots can lack artwork or use an existing font fallback; visual completeness is not passed.
One synthetic save fixture and Chromium do not prove all user-save or Safari/device states.
Browser storage eviction and device quota policies can remove caches; this is not a permanent offline-storage guarantee.
Official baseline, visuals, animation, Tips, all gameplay/chapter/replay rules and complete resources remain unaccepted as recorded in docs/fidelity-acceptance.json.
remoteCI: The PR workflow runs this new actual-worker regression. The final pushed SHA and its raw logs must be read before accepting that CI run.
